963: (19) It is forbidden to apply oil and garlic on the roast while it is opposite the fire, even though the roast was already roasted before Shabbos. {Rama: And the same applies after removing it from the fire, as long as it is boiling and yad soledes bo, for it is still a kli rishon.}
966: (24) 'While it is opposite the fire' — and the same applies after removing it from the fire as long as it is boiling and yad soledes bo — it is forbidden to apply garlic to it, since it is still a kli rishon. And many do not know to be careful about this.
968: (45) 'Opposite the fire' — not specifically, for the same applies if it is boiling and yad soledes bo as written in seif 5 and seif 9, and that is also implied from the language of Rashi. And so write the poskim in Yoreh De'ah that a solid item even in a kli sheni has the concern of cooking.
970: (42) 'The fire' — and the same applies after removing it from the fire as long as it is boiling and yad soledes bo — it is forbidden to apply garlic to it since it is still a kli rishon, and so write the poskim in Yoreh De'ah siman 94.
972: (57) 'Seif 19, forbidden' — Rashi in Kiddushin 1a s.v. shadika.
974: (110) 'Oil and garlic' — which are not cooked.
976: (111) 'While opposite the fire' — and then it is very hot.
978: (112) 'The garlic and the oil' — from the heat of the roast, according to the rule we saw at the beginning of the siman, that toldos ha'or are like fire.
